description.value: Yaas Grill House is a family-owned Persian restaurant that has been serving the North Shore community for over three decades, specializing in halal kababs, traditional stews, and an extensive range of vegetarian dishes. Situated on Lonsdale Avenue — a primary cycling corridor through North Vancouver — it offers dine-in, takeout, delivery, and catering, with a high-turnover kitchen that emphasizes freshness across its Iranian-inspired menu.

address.value: 2057 Lonsdale Ave, North Vancouver, BC V7M 2K6
